qs.q: What time does he get up?
What does he do first after getting up?
What does he do in the evening?

gram.d: First… then…: 先喝咖啡，再吃早餐 — orders two actions. You met this in the MRT reading; now use it for your own routine.

qs.q: Who does he often meet with?

gram.d: 想 before a verb = want to / would like to: 我想學更多 — I want to learn more. Softer than 要.
還是 makes an either/or question: 大杯還是小杯？ — large or small? No 嗎 needed; the choice itself makes it a question.

qs.q: How many people are in his family?
How often does he call them?

gram.d: 想 + person = to miss someone: 我很想他們. Same word as 'want to' — context decides. Note Taiwan reads 和 as hàn in careful speech.

readings.title: 搭捷運上班 Taking the MRT to Work (stretch)

qs.q: How does he get to work?
What is the MRT like inside?

gram.d: From A to B: 從我家到公司要二十分鐘 — works for places and times (從八點到五點, from 8 to 5).

dict.en: What do you want to drink?

dict.py: Wǒ yào yì bēi rè kāfēi.

pass.zh: 大家好，我叫小陳，是台灣人。我在一家科技公司工作，工作很忙。我每天喝兩杯咖啡。很高興認識你們！

qs.q: How many coffees does he drink daily?

dict.py: Zǎo'ān! Nǐ chī zǎocān le ma?
dict.en: Good morning! Have you had breakfast?

dict.py: Wǒ jīntiān hěn máng, yě hěn lèi.
dict.en: I'm busy today, and tired too.

dict.py: Nǐ de diànhuà hàomǎ shì duōshǎo?

pass.zh: 歡迎光臨！今天咖啡買一送一，熱的冷的都可以。要大杯還是小杯？

qs.q: What choice does the clerk offer?

scenarios.intro: A new Taiwanese colleague introduces herself in the office kitchen. Exchange names, where you're from, and a friendly goodbye.

them.zh: 你好！我叫林小美，你好嗎？
them.py: Nǐ hǎo! Wǒ jiào Lín Xiǎoměi, nǐ hǎo ma?
them.en: Hi! I'm Lin Xiaomei. How are you?

turns.task: Say hello, you're well, and give your name.

ans.py: Nǐ hǎo! Wǒ hěn hǎo. Wǒ jiào Eric.
ans.en: Hello! I'm well. My name is Eric.

them.py: Eric nǐ hǎo! Nǐ shì nǎ guó rén?
them.en: Hi Eric! Which country are you from?

turns.task: Say you're American.

them.py: Nǐ huì shuō Zhōngwén éi, hěn bàng!

turns.task: Say you only speak a little; you're learning.

ans.zh: 我會說一點，我在學中文。
ans.py: Wǒ huì shuō yìdiǎn, wǒ zài xué Zhōngwén.
ans.en: I speak a little — I'm learning.

them.py: Yào bú yào yìqǐ hē kāfēi?
them.en: Want to grab a coffee together?

turns.task: Say yes! You really like coffee.

ans.py: Hǎo a! Wǒ hěn xǐhuān hē kāfēi.

turns.task: Say okay, thanks!

scenarios.intro: A simple drink-stand run: order a tea, pick the size, pay cash, say bye.

them.en: Welcome! What would you like to drink?

turns.task: Say you want one iced tea.

ans.py: Nǐ hǎo, wǒ yào yì bēi bīng chá.

turns.task: Say large.
Say here you go (給你) — you're paying cash.

them.zh: 找你五十塊。你的茶好了！
them.py: Zhǎo nǐ wǔshí kuài. Nǐ de chá hǎo le!
them.en: Fifty in change. Your tea's ready!

turns.task: Say thanks, it looks tasty.
Say bye-bye!

scenarios.intro: Lunch at a small eatery: get a table for one, order noodles and water, ask for the check.

turns.task: Say just one person.

them.en: Have a seat. What would you like?

turns.task: Order one bowl of beef noodles (牛肉麵 niúròumiàn).

them.py: Hǎo de. Yào hē de ma?

turns.task: Ask for a glass of water.

ans.py: Qǐng gěi wǒ yì bēi shuǐ, xièxie.
ans.en: A glass of water please, thanks.

turns.task: Say thanks — it's delicious!
Say yes — and ask for the check.

scenarios.intro: You're looking for a convenience store and a restroom. Stop a friendly stranger and ask.

turns.task: Say excuse me — is there a 7-11 nearby?

ans.zh: 不好意思，請問附近有 7-11 嗎？
ans.py: Bù hǎo yìsi, qǐngwèn fùjìn yǒu 7-11 ma?
ans.en: Excuse me, is there a 7-11 nearby?

them.py: Yǒu o, qiánmiàn yòu zhuǎn jiù dào le.
them.en: Yep — turn right up ahead and you're there.

turns.task: Repeat it back: turn right up ahead?

them.py: Duì duì duì, zǒulù liǎng fēnzhōng.

turns.task: Ask one more thing: where is the restroom?
Great — thank them for the help.

ans.py: Tài hǎo le, xièxie nǐ de bāngmáng!

turns.task: Say bye!

scenarios.intro: A first video call with a Taiwanese partner company. Introduce yourself and your company in simple Mandarin — your future L6 briefings start here.

them.zh: 哈囉，聽得到嗎？請先自我介紹一下！
them.py: Hāluō, tīng de dào ma? Qǐng xiān zìwǒ jièshào yíxià!
them.en: Hello, can you hear me? Please introduce yourself!

turns.task: Say hello — your name is Eric, you're an engineer.

ans.zh: 哈囉，聽得到。我叫 Eric，我是工程師。
ans.py: Hāluō, tīng de dào. Wǒ jiào Eric, wǒ shì gōngchéngshī.
ans.en: Hello, I can hear you. I'm Eric, an engineer.

turns.task: Say your company makes drones.

them.zh: 哇，很酷欸！你來過台灣嗎？
them.py: Wā, hěn kù éi! Nǐ láiguò Táiwān ma?
them.en: Wow, cool! Have you been to Taiwan?

turns.task: Say yes, you really like Taiwan.

them.zh: 太好了！我們想跟你們合作。
them.py: Tài hǎo le! Wǒmen xiǎng gēn nǐmen hézuò.
them.en: Great! We'd like to work with you.

turns.task: Say thank you — you'd like that too (也想).

ans.zh: 謝謝！我們也想跟你們合作。
ans.py: Xièxie! Wǒmen yě xiǎng gēn nǐmen hézuò.

them.py: Nà xià xīngqí kāihuì, hǎo ma?
them.en: Then let's meet next week, okay?

turns.task: Say okay — see you next week!

vocab.n: Taiwan says 早安 or just 早; you'll hear 早 alone constantly at work.

x: Mr. Ma, please have a seat.
Lín xiǎojiě shì wǒ de tóngshì.
vocab.n: Perfectly polite in Taiwan (unlike parts of the mainland where it can be avoided).

x: Nǐ de gōngzuò máng bù máng?

vocab.n: 好 + adjective + 喔 = very Taiwanese way to sigh about something.
早餐店 culture is a Taiwan institution — 蛋餅, 飯糰, 奶茶.

x: What do you want for dinner?
Zhè jiā diàn de miànbāo hěn yǒumíng.
I drink milk in the morning.

vocab.e: to want to; to think; to miss
x: I want to go work in Taiwan.
Wǒ děng yíxià dǎ diànhuà gěi nǐ.
I'll call you in a bit.
可以給我你的電話號碼嗎？
Kěyǐ gěi wǒ nǐ de diànhuà hàomǎ ma?
Could I get your phone number?

slang.n: From English. The default casual goodbye in Taiwan — more common than 再見 among friends.
The 喔 makes agreement sound warm and easygoing. Texting essential.
